answer: Multilateration curbs Sybil attacks in AI-agent economies using simultaneous signed challenges from verifiers across separate ocean regions. Verifiers run ridge regression on round-trip latency residuals against reference mirror nodes to spot correlated timing from co-located hosts. Attackers must rent dispersed physical hosts and bandwidth per identity instead of cloning local processes. However, asymmetric BGP routing can skew delay estimates and reject honest agents using VPNs.
